title: Gold set expansion with held-out split
description: Expand the synthetic gold set with harder cases (sarcasm, frustrated-but-polite, terse commands, mixed sentiment, coding jargon); keep existing VADER-tuning cases separate from new held-out eval cases; eval reports accuracy on held-out only plus confusion matrix per backend.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Held-out gold set added at annotations/KDATAP-5fc7c8/sentiment-gold-heldout.yaml: 28 harder synthetic cases in five kinds (5 sarcasm neg, 4 frustrated-but-polite neg, 5 terse commands neu, 4 mixed-sentiment neg, 4 coding-jargon neu, 4 positive pos, 2 excluded), kept separate from the VADER-tuning set (KDATAP-fe4c1d). The eval harness reports held-out accuracy, per-kind accuracy, and pos/neu/neg confusion matrices per backend; tuning-set accuracy is reported separately for continuity.
